payload.prompt: Create the product "Training Session" with product number 2451. The price is 20350 NOK excluding VAT, using the standard 25% VAT rate.

payload.goal: Create product "Training Session" with product number 2451 priced at 20350 NOK excluding VAT and standard 25% VAT.
success_checks: Sales price excluding VAT is 20350 NOK.
risk_notes: No unit/type/category specified for the product.
Assumes standard VAT code/rate 25% is available in the environment.
payload.suggested_first_action: Create the product master record with name, product number, price excluding VAT, and 25% VAT.
ordered_steps: Check available VAT rates and confirm standard 25% VAT exists.
POST product with name="Training Session", productNumber="2451", priceExcludingVat=20350, vatRatePercent=25, currency="NOK" if supported.
Verify the created product record returns the expected name, product number, price, and VAT rate.

rules: ALWAYS search first if product_number is provided: GET /product?number=<number> — sandbox pre-seeds products.
Only POST /product if GET returns 0 results.
Use 'number' field for the product number (NOT productNumber).
priceExcludingVat sets the base price. Also set vatType={"id": 3|5|6}.

payload.trace_example_task: Create product with number, price, and VAT. 2 API calls, 0 errors.
